name: studio-easing-curves
description: Easing presets for tweens, camera moves, retimes and UI motion. The names map 1:1 to the ease() implementations in tools-anim.py; this asset documents them for planning tools and external consumers.

linear.use: mechanical motion, cameras, fades under music beats

cubic_out.use: fast attack decelerating into a hold

timing_rules.applies: almost all organic motion; add spacing charts

timing_rules.frames: 4-10 after a stop, scaled to mass

timing_rules.amount: 5-15 percent of the move, then 1-2 corrective swings

camera_move_defaults.truck_in: cubic_in_out; keep 10 percent margin at frame edges
